goal: Reduce agent noise at the source by routing all extracted tasks to the review queue instead of auto-creating them, surfacing existing tasks to the extraction model so duplicates are suppressed at the prompt level, adding last-mile exact-title dedup before any auto-creation, and marking activity-update notes as AI-processed so they don't accumulate as zombie pending rows. Net effect: agent correction tax (deletions/reverts) drops materially and inbox acceptance rate rises; no new entity types or schemas.
userProblem: Live data: 109 ai_capture tasks created, 56 deleted by user (51% correction tax on tasks). Of 67 active tasks, only 11 are done (16% completion rate). 32 of 33 activity_update notes stuck in ai_status=pending forever because they bypass reconciliation. The capture extraction prompt over-generates (says 'prefer over-extraction'), the extraction model has zero visibility into existing tasks (only projects/areas), and the activity_update path auto-creates tasks with no dedup at all. Tier 1 cut some of the worst noise but the AI is still doing too much curation work on the user's behalf.
whyNow: The four fixes are small, independent, and high-ROI per Loopsmith's per-task validator discipline. Each can ship on its own branch with a tight test. Tier 1 of the noise-reduction work shipped on 2026-06-26 (untitled-fallback + gpt-5.4-nano) — Tier 2 closes the remaining extraction and gating gaps. Without Tier 2 the agent's correction tax stays above 30% and the inbox loses trust.

tasks.title: Exact-title dedup before any auto-creation (capture + activity_update)
tasks.description: Both the capture path (_can_auto_create_entity → _auto_create_entity) and the activity_update path (create_activity_update at line ~1813) call _auto_create_entity without a final exact-title check. _find_existing_entity already exists at line ~4631 and does a case-insensitive title lookup, but is never called from either auto-create path. Add a single last-mile guard in _auto_create_entity itself: if an active entity of the same type with case-insensitive matching title already exists, return the existing entity instead of minting a duplicate. The caller already handles 'entity was returned vs created' semantics by checking entity.id, but to avoid touching every caller, have _auto_create_entity return the existing entity and rely on _create_entity_link being idempotent on (source_id, target_id, relationship_type) duplicates.

tasks.title: Force derived_from on task extraction link path + deterministic test mocks
tasks.description: Real bug found during Tier-2 verification: _apply_reconciliation_decision only set relationship_type=derived_from for action==new tasks. Fixed by broadening the override to apply to all task entities regardless of action. Also fixed three flaky tests that asserted on non-deterministic LLM-picked relationship_type values by mocking services.v4_reconciliation.reconcile_candidates to return deterministic decisions. All 184 integration tests + 127 unit tests pass.

tasks.title: Mark activity-update notes as AI-processed at creation time
tasks.description: 32 of 33 activity_update notes have ai_status=pending forever — they bypass full reconciliation but the lightweight extraction doesn't set ai_status. They're filtered out of the inbox (line ~585 excludes source='activity_update'), but they exist as zombie rows that confuse the Needs review counter and may trigger embed jobs that never run. Simple fix: in api/v4_entities.py::_create_activity_update_note (called by POST /api/v4/entities/<id>/activity_updates), set note.ai_status='done' since the lightweight extraction already ran. Tests: add test_activity_update_note_is_marked_ai_done_on_creation that creates an activity update and asserts ai_status='done'. Existing activity update tests must still pass.
